title_en: 3 apartments of typology 1+1 for sale in the well-known complex under construction "Collonade" near Zogu te Zi
description_en: 3 apartments of typology 1+1 are for sale in the well-known building complex "Collonade" near Zogu te Zi. The apartments are located on the 2nd residential floor, have a regular floor plan, respectively 71.6, 72.2 and 81 m² and are sold at a bargain price of 1,800 euros/m² (starting from 129,000 euros)
